sourceQuote: These students are going to study for a master's or straight PHD; 11 students choose to Beijing university, Tsinghua university and Renmin university of China to pursue advanced studies and other domestic famous universities.
targetQuote: 这些学生将攻读硕士学位或直接攻读博士学位；11名学生选择进入北京大学、清华大学、中国人民大学等高校继续深造，也有学生进入其他国内知名高校。
